blocks.en: Laplace's equation and the wave equation differ in other important aspects. For example, solutions of \eqref{eq:classification-laplace} will always be smooth in the interior of the domain as long as $f$ is smooth. On the other hand, solutions of \eqref{eq:classification-wave} may have discontinuities even for $f=0$. Indeed, as we mentioned in the previous chapter, any twice differentiable function of the form $u=F(x-y)+G(x+y)$ is a solution of \eqref{eq:classification-wave}, and we shall later introduce "generalized" solutions which dispense with the requirement that $F$ and $G$ have to be twice differentiable.
blocks.zh: Laplace 方程和波动方程在其他重要方面也有不同. 例如, 只要 $f$ 光滑, \eqref{eq:classification-laplace} 的解在区域内部总是光滑的. 另一方面, 即使 $f=0$, \eqref{eq:classification-wave} 的解也可能具有间断. 事实上, 如上一章所述, 任意形如 $u=F(x-y)+G(x+y)$ 的二次可微函数都是 \eqref{eq:classification-wave} 的解; 后面将引入"广义"解, 不再要求 $F$ 和 $G$ 必须二次可微.

blocks.en: An important ingredient of a systematic theory of partial differential equations is a classification scheme which identifies classes of equations with common properties. The "type" of an equation determines the nature of boundary and initial conditions which may be imposed, the nature of singularities which solutions may have and the nature of methods which can be used to approximate a solution. In this section, we shall provide the basic definitions underlying the classification of PDEs.
blocks.zh: 偏微分方程系统理论的一个重要组成部分, 是识别具有共同性质的方程类的分类方案. 方程的"类型"决定了可以施加什么性质的边界条件和初始条件, 解可能具有什么性质的奇性, 以及可以用什么性质的方法来近似求解. 本节给出偏微分方程分类所依据的基本定义.

blocks.en: The symbol of Laplace's operator $\partial^2/\partial x_1^2+\partial^2/\partial x_2^2$ is $-\xi_1^2-\xi_2^2$, the symbol of the heat operator $\partial/\partial x_1-\partial^2/\partial x_2^2$ is $i\xi_1+\xi_2^2$, and the symbol of the wave operator $\partial^2/\partial x_1^2-\partial^2/\partial x_2^2$ is $-\xi_1^2+\xi_2^2$. For the Laplace and wave operator, the symbols are equal to their principal parts; the principal part for the heat operator is $\xi_2^2$.
blocks.zh: Laplace 算子 $\partial^2/\partial x_1^2+\partial^2/\partial x_2^2$ 的符号为 $-\xi_1^2-\xi_2^2$, 热算子 $\partial/\partial x_1-\partial^2/\partial x_2^2$ 的符号为 $i\xi_1+\xi_2^2$, 波动算子 $\partial^2/\partial x_1^2-\partial^2/\partial x_2^2$ 的符号为 $-\xi_1^2+\xi_2^2$. 对 Laplace 算子和波动算子, 符号等于其主部; 热算子符号的主部为 $\xi_2^2$.
blocks.label: ex:classical-differential-symbols

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In an analogous fashion, we can associate a matrix-valued symbol with a system of partial differential equations. The definition of the principal part in this case is more involved; we shall address this issue in a later subsection.
blocks.zh: 类似地, 可以为一组偏微分方程对应一个矩阵值符号. 此时主部的定义更为复杂; 后面的小节将讨论这个问题.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In general, the symbol tells us how a differential expression acts on functions which have their support contained in a small neighborhood of a given point $\bm{x}$. If the coefficients are smooth, they are approximately constant in such a small neighborhood. Moreover, if $u$ varies very rapidly, the highest-order derivatives are dominant over lower-order derivatives, and the principal part therefore contains the most important terms. How the differential expression acts on rapidly varying functions of small support is of crucial importance for many basic properties of PDEs. The classification into types is based on the principal part of the symbol.
blocks.zh: 一般地, 符号告诉我们, 微分表达式如何作用于支集包含在给定点 $\bm{x}$ 的一个小邻域内的函数. 如果系数光滑, 那么在这样的小邻域中它们近似为常数. 此外, 如果 $u$ 变化得非常快, 最高阶导数就占据主导地位, 超过低阶导数, 因而主部包含最重要的项. 微分表达式如何作用于支集很小且快速变化的函数, 对偏微分方程的许多基本性质至关重要. 方程类型的分类依据符号的主部.

blocks.en: Recall that a quadratic form is called definite if the associated symmetric matrix is (positive or negative) definite, it is called indefinite if the matrix has eigenvalues of both signs, and it is called degenerate if the matrix is singular.
blocks.zh: 回顾, 若对应的对称矩阵是 (正或负) 定的, 则称二次型为定号的; 若矩阵具有正负两种符号的特征值, 则称为不定的; 若矩阵奇异, 则称为退化的.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The differential equation \eqref{eq:second-order-scalar-expression} is called \textbf{elliptic} if the quadratic form given by \eqref{eq:second-order-quadratic-symbol} is strictly definite, \textbf{hyperbolic} if it is indefinite and \textbf{parabolic} if it is degenerate.
blocks.zh: 微分方程 \eqref{eq:second-order-scalar-expression} 称为\textbf{椭圆型的}, 如果 \eqref{eq:second-order-quadratic-symbol} 给出的二次型严格定号; 若它不定, 则称为\textbf{双曲型的}; 若它退化, 则称为\textbf{抛物型的}.
blocks.label: def:second-order-scalar-type

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The terms elliptic, parabolic and hyperbolic are motivated by the analogy with the classification of conic sections.
blocks.zh: 椭圆型, 抛物型和双曲型这些术语来自与圆锥曲线分类的类比.

blocks.en: Equation \eqref{eq:ndimensional-second-order-equation} is called \textbf{elliptic} if all eigenvalues of $\bm{A}$ have the same sign, \textbf{parabolic} if $\bm{A}$ is singular and \textbf{hyperbolic} if all but one of the eigenvalues of $\bm{A}$ have the same sign and one has the opposite sign. If $\bm{A}$ is nonsingular and there is more than one eigenvalue of each sign, the equation is called \textbf{ultrahyperbolic}.
blocks.zh: 方程 \eqref{eq:ndimensional-second-order-equation} 称为\textbf{椭圆型的}, 如果 $\bm{A}$ 的所有特征值同号; 若 $\bm{A}$ 奇异, 则称为\textbf{抛物型的}; 若 $\bm{A}$ 的特征值除一个外全部同号, 而另一个具有相反符号, 则称为\textbf{双曲型的}. 如果 $\bm{A}$ 非奇异, 且正负两种符号的特征值都不止一个, 则称方程为\textbf{超双曲型的}.
blocks.label: def:ndimensional-second-order-type

blocks.en: In matrix form, condition \eqref{eq:second-order-characteristic-surface} reads $(\nabla\phi)^T\bm{A}(\nabla\phi)=0$. The matrix $\bm{A}$ is strictly definite, i.e., \eqref{eq:ndimensional-second-order-equation} is elliptic if and only if there are no nonzero real vectors with this property. We can therefore characterize elliptic equations as those without (real) characteristic surfaces.
blocks.zh: 条件 \eqref{eq:second-order-characteristic-surface} 的矩阵形式为 $(\nabla\phi)^T\bm{A}(\nabla\phi)=0$. 矩阵 $\bm{A}$ 严格定号, 即 \eqref{eq:ndimensional-second-order-equation} 为椭圆型, 当且仅当不存在具有这一性质的非零实向量. 因而可将椭圆型方程刻画为没有 (实) 特征曲面的方程.
